newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies nine muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies nine muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. said it has qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Prince George's County, Md., $5.488 million unlimited tax bonds.
--Beaverton, Oregon, $9.865 million water revenue bonds is a direct purchase.
--Rosenberg, Texas, $2.075 million water and sewer revs and $3.975 million certificates of obligation.
--Saginaw, Texas, $2.890 million certificates of obligation and $2.190 million waterworks and sewer system revs.
